title: Common radial force and nonzero Schur responses lift two shell contacts to annuli

statement.quantifiers: Five distinct planar shell radii, two contacts with one reflected angular-minimum orbit, positive angular Hessian, exact common source force and strict finite-shell dual gap.

assumptions: c derivatives are ANGULARLY REDUCED Schur derivatives, not fixed-angle raw radial derivatives.
Companion certificate supplies exact finite hypotheses; no numerical annulus width assumed.
